description: 已登录但 PR 创建失败（PAT scope 不足，失败路径）

input.failure_symptom: gh pr create 报 not accessible

strategy.second_step: gh pr create --title test --body test --head test 2>&1 | grep -i 'accessible\|denied'
strategy.diagnosis: If logged in but pr create fails → PAT scope insufficient

sanity_report.issue: gh auth status shows logged in but gh pr create fails with not accessible
sanity_report.root_cause: PAT scope 缺 repo 或 write:repository
sanity_report.fix: Create new Classic PAT with repo + write:repository scope

fix_commands: Create new Classic PAT (repo + write:repository) in GitHub Settings → Developer settings → Tokens
